entities.summary: George Kinzie Fitzsimons was an American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. He served as bishop of Salina in Kansas from 1984 to 2004. Fitzsimons previously served as an auxiliary bishop of the Diocese of Kansas City-St. Joseph in Missouri.
